hasselblad-phocus.works: Phocus Mobile on phone and tablet: the photo fills the screen, and the tools are a thin column of tiny white labels and sliders at the edge, with one orange accent.
hasselblad-phocus.controls: Thin horizontal sliders with a small value at the end; icon buttons in a narrow rail.
hasselblad-phocus.displays: The image is the display; histograms are small and quiet.
hasselblad-phocus.colour: Black chrome, white text, one orange accent dot for the active state.
hasselblad-phocus.lesson: Let the displays be the content and push controls to a quiet rail; one warm accent marks what is active.

hasselblad-x2d.works: The camera's back screen and top display: a few large numbers, plenty of black, almost no chrome.
hasselblad-x2d.controls: Physical dials and a touch screen with large tap targets.
hasselblad-x2d.displays: Big readable values (ISO, shutter) in white on black.
hasselblad-x2d.colour: Black and warm grey metal with one orange button.
hasselblad-x2d.lesson: Large calm numbers on black read as premium; show the value, not a decoration.

hasselblad-x2d-ii.works: Product shots of the camera body: machined grey metal, one orange accent, an X-ray view showing the inside.
hasselblad-x2d-ii.controls: Dials and buttons with a fine knurl.
hasselblad-x2d-ii.lesson: Materials do the talking: one finely machined object with a single warm accent.

te-op1.works: The OP-1 field: a white aluminium body, round coloured encoders, and a small OLED screen that draws each engine as a playful graphic.
te-op1.controls: Four colour-coded encoders (blue, green, white, orange), each mapped to the matching colour on screen.
te-op1.displays: Tiny OLED graphics: each engine and effect is a picture (tape reels, a cow, circles) instead of a list of numbers.
te-op1.colour: Off-white body; screen in white, blue, green, orange on black.
te-op1.lesson: Colour-code controls to their place on the display, and draw each module as a picture of what it does.

te-op1-guide.works: The manual's flat drawings of every OP-1 screen: synth engines, envelopes and FX each drawn as a simple graphic.
te-op1-guide.displays: Minimal line graphics on black: waveforms, bars and dots, one colour per encoder.
te-op1-guide.lesson: A display can explain a module with three or four simple shapes; resist drawing everything.

te-opxy.works: OP-XY in black: dark anodised aluminium lit from one side, a tiny screen, the device photographed as sculpture.
te-opxy.controls: A grid of square keys and a few round encoders.
te-opxy.displays: A small screen with dense, crisp line graphics.
te-opxy.colour: All black; light and reflection make the form.
te-opxy.lesson: One raking light on dark material is the whole mood: close to our siren light on black.

te-opxy-guide.works: The OP-XY manual pages: white line drawings and small grey type on pure black.
te-opxy-guide.lesson: Pure black plus thin white line art is enough to explain a complex device.

te-ep133.works: EP-133: a grey machined panel, orange and grey keys, a segmented LCD with tiny icons, labels printed on the panel.
te-ep133.controls: Chunky keys and two big knobs (one orange); labels sit right on the panel.
te-ep133.displays: A segmented LCD with small pictograms: a few things at once, very legible.
te-ep133.colour: Light grey, black, orange as the hero colour, small red labels.
te-ep133.lesson: Print the labels onto the surface and keep the display to a few big readings; one hero colour.

te-ep-sample-tool.works: TE's desktop sample tool: a flat drawing of the device on a pale grid, orange tags as the only accent.
te-ep-sample-tool.controls: Software mirrors the hardware layout one to one.
te-ep-sample-tool.displays: A flat schematic of the device.
te-ep-sample-tool.lesson: Software can echo the hardware's layout so the two feel like one instrument.

te-opz.works: OP-Z: a dark slim body, colour-coded track keys, and a phone app as its screen, with flat white panels and one colour per track.
te-opz.controls: Rows of small round keys, colour rings per track.
te-opz.displays: The app: thin lines, small type, step grid, envelope graphics.
te-opz.colour: Dark grey body; red, yellow, green, blue per track.
te-opz.lesson: Colour-code by function across hardware and screen; keep the screen flat and thin-lined.

te-tx6.works: TX-6: a tiny machined mixer (silver or black) with knurled knobs, short faders and a small display.
te-tx6.controls: Knurled metal knobs and short faders in tight, perfect rows.
te-tx6.displays: A small screen with a big number.
te-tx6.colour: Black or silver metal, green LEDs.
te-tx6.lesson: Density can look premium when everything sits on a strict grid and the materials are real.

apple-logic-pro.works: Logic Pro on Mac and iPad: dark grey panels, coloured regions and instrument faces (Alchemy, Sample Alchemy, ChromaGlow) inside one consistent shell.
apple-logic-pro.controls: Round knobs with value arcs; flat sliders; plug-ins framed by a calm dark shell.
apple-logic-pro.displays: Big waveform and spectrum displays that light up in one colour per area.
apple-logic-pro.colour: Dark grey with blues and purples; colour only on content.
apple-logic-pro.lesson: A neutral, dark shell lets each module's colourful display carry the colour.

apple-final-cut.works: Final Cut Pro: a dark editor with a large viewer, a timeline, and a colour-wheels inspector.
apple-final-cut.controls: Colour wheels and slim sliders in an inspector column.
apple-final-cut.displays: The viewer dominates; scopes are small and precise.
apple-final-cut.colour: Near-black chrome; colour comes from the footage.
apple-final-cut.lesson: Give the main display the most room, controls in a narrow, quiet inspector.

leica-fotos.works: Leica FOTOS: black UI, white type, thumbnails, and Leica red only for the brand mark.
leica-fotos.lesson: Red used once, for the most important thing, reads as luxury: same as our siren rule.

uhe-diva.works: Diva: a hardware-style panel of dark modules on wood cheeks, a red lower section, every section labelled in small caps.
uhe-diva.controls: Many small black knobs with white pointers; vertical sliders for envelopes.
uhe-diva.displays: Almost none: the knobs are the display.
uhe-diva.lesson: Real modules in boxes with headers read instantly; but no displays makes it hard to see what the sound is doing.

uhe-zebra.works: Zebra Legacy: a dense grid of lit panels with big orange editor displays (waveforms, MSEG envelopes).
uhe-zebra.controls: Small knobs in tight rows, tabs per module.
uhe-zebra.displays: Large orange displays that fill whole panels when editing.
uhe-zebra.colour: Dark grey with warm orange displays.
uhe-zebra.lesson: A big warm-coloured display per module plus tight knob rows: closest to our 'display above each module' rule.

uhe-repro.works: Repro-1/5: photoreal hardware (Pro-One, Prophet-5) on wood, plus a pedalboard of coloured stomp boxes.
uhe-repro.controls: Photoreal knobs and switches, each to scale.
uhe-repro.colour: Dark brown panels, wood, colourful pedals.
uhe-repro.lesson: Skeuomorphism works when it is faithful and lit consistently; colour in small separate blocks (the pedals).

serum-2.works: Serum 2: dark navy panels, a big animated display above each oscillator, a matrix of modulation lanes below.
serum-2.controls: Small round knobs with blue value rings; drag-to-modulate.
serum-2.displays: Big waveform and wavetable displays above the knobs; LFO shape editors.
serum-2.colour: Dark navy, bright blue and green traces.
serum-2.lesson: The display-above-knobs layout is the genre standard; Serum's value rings make every amount readable at a glance.

surge-xt.works: Surge XT: a dense flat panel (grey, orange, blue skins), every module on one page, sliders everywhere.
surge-xt.controls: Horizontal and vertical sliders more than knobs.
surge-xt.displays: Small displays for oscillator and filter, a modulation list.
surge-xt.colour: Skinnable; default grey with orange and blue.
surge-xt.lesson: Shows the cost of fitting everything on one flat page: functional but busy. Hierarchy needs size and space, not more boxes.

phase-plant.works: Phase Plant: modules as stacked cards with a display each; modulation drawn as curved lines between source and target.
phase-plant.controls: Small knobs, value readouts under each.
phase-plant.displays: A waveform in every generator card, envelopes drawn as curves.
phase-plant.colour: Mid grey with blue traces and green modulation lines.
phase-plant.lesson: Draw modulation as a visible connection; cards with one display each keep a modular synth readable.

pigments.works: Pigments: a near-black synth with big animated, colour-coded displays and a coloured modulation system.
pigments.controls: Knobs with colour arcs; modulation sources colour-code their targets.
pigments.displays: Large, vivid, animated displays per engine.
pigments.colour: Black UI, saturated blue/orange/purple per section.
pigments.lesson: Colour-code by role (source colour on its targets) and animate the displays: alive without extra controls.

arturia-v-collection.works: V Collection: faithful vintage recreations plus a modern toolbar and preset browser around them.
arturia-v-collection.displays: Mostly none on the instrument faces.
arturia-v-collection.colour: Each instrument's own colours; the shell is neutral.
arturia-v-collection.lesson: A neutral modern shell can frame a very skeuomorphic face without clashing.

arturia-mini-v.works: Mini V: a photoreal Minimoog (wood, black panel, blue switches) with an advanced modern panel that slides out above.
arturia-mini-v.controls: Photoreal black knobs with skirts, coloured rocker switches.
arturia-mini-v.displays: The advanced panel adds modern displays (envelopes, curves) above the hardware face.
arturia-mini-v.colour: Black panel, wood, blue and orange switches, red/orange displays.
arturia-mini-v.lesson: Hardware look for the main face, modern displays on top: a direct model for skeuo plus displays.

fabfilter-pro-q.works: Pro-Q 4: one huge interactive display is the interface; controls appear only near the band you touch.
fabfilter-pro-q.controls: A floating panel of three knobs under the selected band.
fabfilter-pro-q.displays: A full-width spectrum and EQ curve with coloured band fills.
fabfilter-pro-q.colour: Dark grey-purple, one colour per band, glowing curves.
fabfilter-pro-q.lesson: Let the display be the control; keep the knob strip small and contextual.

fabfilter-saturn.works: Saturn 2: dark red, a spectrum display with band splits, drive knobs in a strip, modulation sources as small cards.
fabfilter-saturn.controls: Big red drive knob, smaller knobs around it; mod cards below.
fabfilter-saturn.displays: A spectrum display behind the band split.
fabfilter-saturn.colour: Black and deep red, small coloured mod cards.
fabfilter-saturn.lesson: Proof a distortion UI can live in deep red and black and still be clear: close to our siren palette.

soundtoys-decapitator.works: Decapitator: a hardware-style box with a VU meter, chunky knobs and a style switch row.
soundtoys-decapitator.controls: Few large knobs with scales printed round them.
soundtoys-decapitator.colour: Black panel, wood edges, orange highlight.
soundtoys-decapitator.lesson: Few, big, characterful controls with printed scales feel instantly playable.

baby-audio.works: Baby Audio's range: every plug-in art-directed (pastel, chrome, retro hardware), each a strong object.
baby-audio.controls: Rounded knobs, big buttons, one hero control per plug-in.
baby-audio.lesson: One hero control and a strong object shape make a plugin memorable; we would keep one palette across pages.

valhalla.works: VintageVerb: a flat strip of labelled knobs in boxes, one big decay knob, colour themes (1970s, 1980s, Now).
valhalla.controls: Plain round knobs with value text under each; one oversized key knob.
valhalla.lesson: Function first: one big knob for the main move and flat, readable values. Size shows importance.

minimal-audio-current.works: Current: a dark navy synth with a large central circular display, keys and macros at the bottom.
minimal-audio-current.controls: Small knobs, slim sliders, a macro row.
minimal-audio-current.displays: A big circular, animated sound display at the centre.
minimal-audio-current.lesson: One big, beautiful central display gives a synth a face.

output-arcade.works: Arcade: a dark circular performance view with orange dots and a browser panel beside it.
output-arcade.controls: Round dial with points; macro knobs.
output-arcade.displays: Circular visuals around a central dial.
output-arcade.lesson: A round 'instrument face' feels playable and cinematic.

massive-x.works: Massive X: dark, dense, modular panels with small blue displays and a large routing view.
massive-x.controls: Many small knobs with blue rings, tab rows.
massive-x.displays: Small waveform and envelope displays per module.
massive-x.colour: Charcoal with blue and green traces.
massive-x.lesson: Density works when every module has the same grid and the same knob; but too many tabs hide things.

omnisphere.works: Omnisphere: a deep navy synth with a central display, layer tabs, and FX racks drawn as hardware units.
omnisphere.controls: Flat knobs and sliders; FX units with skeuo faceplates.
omnisphere.displays: A central waveform display and per-layer views.
omnisphere.colour: Navy and blue with light grey.
omnisphere.lesson: Drawing effects as small hardware units makes a long chain readable.

moog-one.works: Moog's own product shots (Labyrinth, Muse): black panels, white legends, rows of black knobs, orange LEDs, wood sides.
moog-one.controls: Classic Moog knobs with skirts and white pointers.
moog-one.colour: Black, white, wood, a few orange LEDs.
moog-one.lesson: Black panel, white legends, wood and a few orange LEDs is already close to RUIN-1's DNA.

elektron-digitone.works: Digitone II: a dark panel, a small high-contrast OLED with big pixel type and icons, encoders round it.
elektron-digitone.controls: Rows of identical encoders, trig keys with coloured LEDs.
elektron-digitone.displays: An OLED drawing each parameter page as icons and big numbers.
elektron-digitone.colour: Black and grey with teal and red LEDs.
elektron-digitone.lesson: A tiny screen can carry a whole page if type is big and each parameter gets an icon.

elektron-syntakt.works: Syntakt: the same Elektron language lit in blue: pixel-type OLED pages, numbered trig keys.
elektron-syntakt.controls: Encoders, numbered square keys with coloured legends.
elektron-syntakt.displays: OLED pages of icons (tune, decay, mod) above the encoders they map to.
elektron-syntakt.colour: Dark panel, blue and red legends.
elektron-syntakt.lesson: Map the screen's layout to the knobs under it: the display above each control row.

buchla.works: Buchla Easel and 200 series: white panels with colour-coded jacks, knobs and sliders.
buchla.controls: Coloured knobs and slider caps by function.
buchla.displays: None; the panel is the display.
buchla.colour: White, with red, blue, green, yellow by function.
buchla.lesson: Colour by function across a whole panel; an iconic, strange-but-precise look.

make-noise.works: 0-Coast: a black panel with hand-drawn white graphics and coloured jacks.
make-noise.controls: Knobs of different sizes, coloured jacks.
make-noise.colour: Black, white line art, a few colours.
make-noise.lesson: Hand-drawn panel graphics give character; flow lines can explain signal path.

eventide-h90.works: H90: a white pedal with a dense OLED, a red knob, lit footswitches.
eventide-h90.displays: An OLED with program names and small parameter icons.
eventide-h90.colour: White, black, a single red knob, green/red LEDs.
eventide-h90.lesson: A single red hero control on a neutral body: our Buy-button rule in hardware.

polyend-tracker.works: Tracker+: a black device with a dense colour screen, white pads, coloured function keys.
polyend-tracker.controls: White square pads, a big jog wheel.
polyend-tracker.displays: A dense colourful tracker screen; colour-coded patterns.
polyend-tracker.colour: Black and white with pastel accents.
polyend-tracker.lesson: A dense screen stays readable with a monospaced grid and colour per track.

dirtywave-m8.works: M8: a tiny black device with a pixel tracker screen, photographed in dark, contrasty light.
dirtywave-m8.lesson: A small glowing screen in a dark object, lit hard from one side: a cinematic product mood.

erica-synths.works: Erica Synths: black industrial hardware with red lit keys, sliders and lots of knobs, shot in the dark.
erica-synths.colour: Black, red, wood on some units.
erica-synths.lesson: Black hardware with red light in the dark: almost exactly the siren mood, in a real instrument.

ableton-push.works: Push 3: a black surface with a glowing RGB pad grid and a display bar above the encoders.
ableton-push.controls: Encoders in a row under a display strip; lit pads.
ableton-push.displays: A long thin display above the encoder row.
ableton-push.lesson: A display strip directly above a row of encoders: one screen, one row of controls, direct mapping.

output-portal.works: Portal: a dark granular FX with a large circular particle display and a column of knobs at the side.
output-portal.controls: A few knobs in a side column.
output-portal.lesson: A big living display plus a narrow control column feels cinematic and calm.

heavyocity-damage.works: Damage 2: rusted, burnt metal backgrounds, worn type and glowing knobs; the most LORN-like UI in the library.
heavyocity-damage.controls: Dark knobs with orange glow, a big central 'punish' knob.
heavyocity-damage.displays: Waveform and stage displays printed on rust.
heavyocity-damage.colour: Rust, burnt orange, black, warm glow.
heavyocity-damage.lesson: Wear and rust as texture under clean controls reads as dangerous and cinematic; keep controls clean on top.

ni-straylight.works: Straylight: a bold orange sound-design face with a waveform strip on top and modules below.
ni-straylight.controls: Small knobs and sliders under each section header.
ni-straylight.displays: A wide waveform display on top, a cinematic image on the perform page.
ni-straylight.lesson: One bold colour per product can be the brand; a wide display on top anchors the page.

slate-ash.works: Slate + Ash: muted olive and grey faces, thin type, a waveform floating in space; restrained and cinematic.
slate-ash.displays: A single waveform as the centrepiece.
slate-ash.lesson: Restraint and thin type feel expensive and cinematic; colour can be muted and still strong.

goodhertz.works: Goodhertz: playful pastel plugins with big type, thin lines, a coloured side bar and a clear signal flow.
goodhertz.controls: Slim faders, small chips for values.
goodhertz.colour: Pastels with one strong colour each.
goodhertz.lesson: Typographic UI: big labels and clear sections can replace boxes and bevels.

glitchmachines.works: Hysteresis: a dark panel of blue-ringed knobs grouped in labelled sections, plus a 3D render of it as hardware.
glitchmachines.controls: Uniform knobs with blue rings, section headers.
glitchmachines.lesson: Grouping knobs into named sections on black is the minimum that works.

arturia-mello-fi.works: Tape MELLO-FI: a silver hardware box with a VU meter, a tape window and chunky knobs.
arturia-mello-fi.controls: Big black knobs with hex grips, a vertical slider.
arturia-mello-fi.displays: A VU meter and a tape reel window.
arturia-mello-fi.lesson: Show the tape: a window onto the reel tells you what the effect does without words.

xln-rc20.works: RC-20: six coloured modules (noise, wobble, distortion, digital, space, magnetic) side by side, each with a display and knobs.
xln-rc20.controls: Cream knobs with coloured rings, a big flux display per module.
xln-rc20.displays: An animated display on top of each module.
xln-rc20.colour: Retro cream with a different colour per module.
xln-rc20.lesson: Six modules, each with its own colour and a display on top: a direct model for a page of modules.

davinci-resolve.works: Resolve: an extremely dense dark UI (edit, colour, Fairlight audio) that still looks calm: everything aligned, small grey type, colour only in content.
davinci-resolve.controls: Colour wheels, slim sliders, knob rows in the mixer.
davinci-resolve.displays: Big viewer, precise scopes, waveform lanes.
davinci-resolve.colour: Very dark grey, white text, coloured content.
davinci-resolve.lesson: Hundreds of controls stay calm with strict alignment, small muted labels and colour only where content is.

ableton-live.works: Live: flat, functional, zero decoration; devices sit side by side in a strip, each with a small display.
ableton-live.colour: Light or dark themes, muted colours.
ableton-live.lesson: Flat and plain is fine if every device has the same grammar.

bitwig.works: Bitwig: a dark DAW with colourful clips, a modular grid and modulators that show their movement on the targets.
bitwig.colour: Dark grey with saturated clip colours and orange accent.
bitwig.lesson: Show modulation on the target knob (a moving ring), not only on the source.

pixelmator-pro.works: Pixelmator Pro: an Apple-like dark editor, calm side panels and a beautiful colour wheel.
pixelmator-pro.controls: Rounded sliders in grouped panels, a big colour wheel.
pixelmator-pro.colour: Black, white, colour in content only.
pixelmator-pro.lesson: Apple restraint: one beautiful custom control (the wheel) among plain ones.

linear.works: Linear: premium dark software: tiny precise type, almost no colour, depth from subtle surfaces.
linear.lesson: Premium dark comes from precise small type and very subtle surface steps, not decoration.

capture-one.works: Capture One: a dark photo editor with tool panels and a large colour wheel.
capture-one.controls: Sliders and wheels in a tool panel.
capture-one.lesson: Pro editors put the controls in one column so the display gets the space.

resolume.works: Resolume: a dark, dense VJ app: a grid of clips, panels of parameters, node wiring.
resolume.controls: Small sliders and buttons in dense panels.
resolume.displays: Clip thumbnails and a big output view.
resolume.lesson: Performance software keeps everything visible at once; density with a clear grid.

cubase.works: Cubase: a big DAW with mixers, channel strips and editors on a dark grey theme.
cubase.colour: Dark grey with blue and colourful tracks.
cubase.lesson: Channel-strip layouts (one column per source) are a familiar way to show many sources.

max.works: Max: patchable audio software: boxes connected by cords, with live UI objects (sliders, scopes, keys).
max.controls: Simple sliders, dials and toggles placed freely.
max.lesson: Signal flow drawn as wires makes routing obvious; free placement gets messy fast.

houdini.works: Houdini: deep technical software with node networks and long parameter panels.
houdini.controls: Parameter rows with sliders and fields.
houdini.lesson: Parameter rows in a strict list are clear for depth, but dull for an instrument.
